summary: Chunk 2048 for the Metal 35B recipe gives +26% prefill at 4k (1300/1347 -> 1674/1677 tok/s, quiet slot, two runs each) but does not fix long_docs_4k continue: it is a near-tie that diverges at token 8 at chunk 256, 1024 and 2048. Building continue oracles for the 4k golden's prompt ids (frozen Metal stream, CPU f64 oracle on endor, splits 2000 and 3072) made Metal 35B qualify PASS (exit 0) on #104 at chunk 256 and on #109 at chunk 2048 with the oracle-relative rule unchanged (ratios 0.99x and 1.16x, limit 1.5x + 3e-3).
lessons: Metal baselines, envelope and CPU-oracle self-golden are chunk-tied; changing a recipe chunk means re-recording them (accuracy/baseline.rs strict config check).
qualify's reuse gate runs at min(plan chunk, 1024), accuracy --mode all at the plan chunk, so the 4k golden needs continue oracles at splits 2000 and 3072.
Oracle files for a new golden must be named distinctly (-g4k): same model/prompt/split as the long golden's files.

The continue oracle needs only a frozen token list, so the stream can come from Metal and the oracle from endor CPU (14-18 min, 38.7 GB RSS) when spark1 is down; the gate margin at split 3072 is 1.16x vs 1.5x with n=32 rows.
Endor's queue was blocked ~2h by an overdue quiet job (#4256) and then memory (42 GB asked vs 40 free); ask for the RSS you need, not budget+margin.
